# Astra ECS v3.0 - Resources, Runtime Reflection & Editor Integration

## Major Release Highlights

Astra 3.0 introduces a **singleton resource system** for global state and a **comprehensive runtime reflection system** providing EnTT meta-style introspection, field enumeration, attribute decoration, and full ECS integration. This release enables editor tooling, runtime component inspection, and JSON schema generation.

### New Capabilities
- **Resource system** for singleton/global components with SBO optimization
- **Runtime type introspection** with zero overhead when unused
- **Field enumeration** with get/set accessors and attribute metadata
- **Entity inspection API** for editor and debugging tools

## New Features

### Resource System (NEW)
Singleton resources for global state that exists outside the entity-component model:

```cpp
// Add global resources
registry.AddResource<Time>(Time{ 0.0f, 0.016f });
registry.AddResource<InputState>();
registry.AddResource<RenderSettings>(width, height, vsync);

// Access resources
Time* time = registry.GetResource<Time>();
time->deltaTime = 0.016f;

// Check existence
if (registry.HasResource<InputState>()) { ... }

// Remove resources
registry.RemoveResource<RenderSettings>();
```

#### Storage Architecture
- **Sparse-dense pattern** for O(1) access by ComponentID
- **Small Buffer Optimization** - Resources ≤64 bytes stored inline (no heap allocation)
- **Swap-and-pop removal** maintains cache locality
- **Automatic registration** with ComponentRegistry

#### Type-Erased Operations
For command buffers and deferred execution:
```cpp
// Set resource by ID (for CommandBuffer)
resourceStorage.SetByID(componentId, dataPtr, dataSize);

// Remove by ID
resourceStorage.RemoveByID(componentId);

// Get by ID
void* data = resourceStorage.GetByID(componentId);
```

#### Memory Efficiency
```cpp
struct ResourceSlot {
    union Storage {
        alignas(64) std::byte inlineData[64];  // SBO: no allocation
        void* heapPtr;                          // Large resources
    };
    // ... metadata
};

// Memory usage tracking
size_t bytes = resourceStorage.GetMemoryUsage();
```

### Runtime Reflection System (NEW)

#### TypeMeta - Complete Type Metadata
```cpp
const TypeMeta* meta = GetMeta<Transform>();

// Introspect fields
meta->ForEachField([](const FieldInfo& field) {
    std::cout << field.name << " : " << field.typeName << "\n";
});

// Dynamic field access
meta->SetFieldValue(&transform, "x", 100.0f);
float x = meta->GetFieldValue<float>(&transform, "x").value();
```

#### FieldInfo - Field Descriptors with Accessors
- Type-erased `Get<T>()` and `Set<T>()` methods
- Offset, size, alignment metadata
- Compile-time type trait detection (isConst, isPointer, isTrivial)
- Attribute query support

#### Attribute System
Decorator metadata for fields and types:
```cpp
ASTRA_REFLECT_TYPE(Transform)
    ASTRA_REFLECT_FIELD(Transform, x)
        ASTRA_REFLECT_ATTR(Range, -1000.0, 1000.0)
        ASTRA_REFLECT_ATTR(DisplayName, "X Position")
        ASTRA_REFLECT_ATTR(Tooltip, "Horizontal position in world space")
    ASTRA_REFLECT_FIELD(Transform, y)
    ASTRA_REFLECT_FIELD(Transform, z);
```

Built-in attributes:
- `Range` - Min/max/step constraints
- `DisplayName` - UI label override
- `Tooltip` - Help text
- `Category` - Property grouping
- `Hidden` - Exclude from inspection
- `ReadOnly` - Prevent modification
- `Serializable` - Control persistence

#### Enum Reflection
```cpp
ASTRA_REFLECT_ENUM(DamageType)
    ASTRA_REFLECT_ENUM_VALUE(DamageType, Physical)
    ASTRA_REFLECT_ENUM_VALUE_NAMED(DamageType, Fire, "Fire Damage")
    ASTRA_REFLECT_ENUM_FLAGS();  // Mark as bitmask

// Runtime conversion
auto name = enumInfo->ToString(DamageType::Fire);  // "Fire Damage"
auto value = enumInfo->FromString("Physical");      // DamageType::Physical
```

#### Container Traits Detection
Automatic detection of container types:
- `std::vector`, `std::array`, `std::span`
- `std::map`, `std::unordered_map`
- `std::set`, `std::unordered_set`
- Custom containers via trait specialization

### ECS-Reflection Integration (NEW)

#### ComponentDescriptor ↔ TypeMeta Linking
Components registered with the ECS are automatically linked to their reflection metadata:
```cpp
// ComponentDescriptor now includes:
const TypeMeta* meta;  // Auto-populated on registration

// Bidirectional lookup
const TypeMeta* meta = GetMeta(componentId);
ComponentID id = MetaRegistry::Instance().GetComponentId(typeHash);
```

#### Entity Inspection API
Runtime inspection of entity components for editors:
```cpp
std::vector<ComponentInfo> components = registry.InspectEntity(entity);

for (const auto& info : components) {
    std::cout << "Component: " << info.descriptor->name << "\n";

    if (info.meta) {
        info.meta->ForEachField([&](const FieldInfo& field) {
            // Render field in editor UI
            RenderFieldWidget(field, info.data);
        });
    }
}
```

#### Resource Inspection API
```cpp
std::vector<ResourceInfo> resources = registry.InspectResources();

for (const auto& res : resources) {
    std::cout << "Resource: " << res.descriptor->name << "\n";
    // Access via res.meta and res.data
}
```

#### Hash-Based Runtime Access
```cpp
// Get components by type hash (runtime lookup)
void* component = registry.GetComponentByHash(entity, typeHash);
bool has = registry.HasComponentByHash(entity, typeHash);

// Get components by name
void* component = registry.GetComponentByName(entity, "Transform");

// Resources
void* resource = registry.GetResourceByHash(typeHash);
bool has = registry.HasResourceByHash(typeHash);
```

### JSON Schema Generation (NEW)
Automatic JSON Schema generation for editor integration:
```cpp
JsonSchemaGenerator generator;
std::string schema = generator.Generate(*GetMeta<Transform>());
```

Generates:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Transform",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "x": { "type": "number", "minimum": -1000, "maximum": 1000 },
    "y": { "type": "number" },
    "z": { "type": "number" }
  },
  "required": ["x", "y", "z"]
}
```

## Architectural Improvements

### MetaRegistry
Global singleton for reflection metadata:
- O(1) lookup by type hash via FlatMap
- Bidirectional component ID ↔ type hash mapping
- Thread-safe registration (single-threaded lookup)
- Lazy initialization via static builders

### Reflection File Structure
```
include/Astra/Reflection/
  Reflection.hpp       # Main include
  TypeMeta.hpp         # Type metadata container
  FieldInfo.hpp        # Field descriptor with get/set
  EnumInfo.hpp         # Enum reflection
  Attribute.hpp        # Attribute base + common attributes
  MetaRegistry.hpp     # Global registry
  ContainerTraits.hpp  # Container type detection
  JsonSchema.hpp       # JSON schema generation
  Macros.hpp           # Registration macros
```

## Requirements
- C++20 compatible compiler (GCC 11+, Clang 13+, MSVC 2022+)
- Premake5 for project generation
- Optional: GoogleTest, Google Benchmark
